items.title: the Jingle Bell x Brazil dance
items.body: arm crosses, chest taps and santa hats, solo or with up to two friends. it's the #1 new trend today with 30K new videos a day. christmas is officially here.

items.title: the ILLIT "Under Arrest" dance
items.creator: ILLIT
items.body: a little police-cap dance, solo, with a squad or WITH A CAT. it's up 115% and still climbing.

items.title: the "tsundere hmph"
items.body: hands on hips, a stomp, arms crossed, "hmph!" people are doing it themselves or getting their pets to do it. extremely cute.

items.title: the Home Alone "Deck the Halls" duo
items.body: two people in matching pajamas, or dressed as Kevin and Harry from Home Alone, doing a little duo routine. so festive.

items.title: gen z is the only optimistic generation at work
items.body: a new Indeed report out today: gen z is the only generation with a net positive outlook on next year's job market. millennials, gen x and boomers are all negative.

items.title: gen z is now 24% of the workforce
items.body: and they already hold 12% of manager roles. they're on track to outnumber boomers in management by 2027.

items.title: free food > dental
items.body: 21% of gen z put free food in their top five benefits, vs 13% of everyone. they rank dental and retirement lower than average.

items.title: 58% want a mentor, 25% have one
items.body: that's a 33-point gap between gen z workers who want a mentor and the ones whose job actually gives them one.
